transit.walk_from_transit: From the bus stop on Ekkamai Road (Sukhumvit 63), walk less than 1 minute into Ekkamai Soi 10. Nunglen x Escobar is immediately on your right.
Take Exit 1 from MRT Wat Mangkon. Walk straight on Mangkon Road towards Charoenkrung Road, then turn left onto Charoenkrung Road. The hotel is a short walk on your right.

name: Boat Noodles Victory Monument
zone: อนุสาวรีย์ชัย

transit.boat: Saphan Hua Chang Pier 1 min walk
transit.walk_from_transit: From Saphan Hua Chang Pier, the boat noodle stalls are immediately visible and accessible along the canal bank.
transit.parking: Limited paid parking available at nearby malls like Century Plaza or private lots in the vicinity.

name: Le Du – Modern Thai Fine Dining

transit.walk_from_transit: From MRT Silom (Exit 2), walk west along Silom Road (away from Rama 4 Road) for approximately 400 meters. Silom Soi 7 will be on your left; Le Du is located inside this soi.
transit.parking: Valet parking available or limited street parking within Silom Soi 7.

transit.walk_from_transit: From BTS Thong Lo (Exit 3), walk straight into Sukhumvit Soi 55 (Thong Lo Road) for about 600 meters. Playground Bangkok will be on your right.
transit.parking: Limited on-site parking available, or paid parking lots can be found nearby in Thong Lo.
